definitions.explanation: A graded level of skill or quality. As a suffix it marks ranks in proficiency tests and martial arts, or a class within a category.

examples.japanese: {漢字検定|かんじけんてい}の{二級|にきゅう}に{合格|ごうかく}した。
examples.english: I passed level 2 of the Kanji Kentei.

examples.japanese: {柔道|じゅうどう}では{茶帯|ちゃおび}が{一級|いっきゅう}だ。
examples.english: In judo, a brown belt is first kyu.

examples.japanese: この{大会|たいかい}は{体重|たいじゅう}ごとに{級|きゅう}が{分|わ}かれている。
examples.english: In this tournament the classes are divided by body weight.

notes:
In ranking systems {級|きゅう} sits below {段|だん} (dan); the numbers count down as skill rises, so {一級|いっきゅう} is the highest kyu, just before reaching dan ranks.

COMPOUNDS:
- {上級|じょうきゅう}: advanced level
- {初級|しょきゅう}: beginner level
- {高級|こうきゅう}: high-class, luxury
- {同級生|どうきゅうせい}: a classmate (same grade)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {段|だん}: the rank above {級|きゅう} in martial arts and board games
- {等級|とうきゅう}: a grade or rating, often for quality or price
